meta.title: Career
meta.description: Join Kreativa Global School. Kreativa Teacher Development Program: a 6-month paid program, Jan–Jun 2027.

hero.title: Join Our Team
hero.body: Join our enthusiastic and dedicated community committed to creating positive change. We are looking for talented and dedicated individuals with a passion for educating the next generation based on Islamic values.

program.title: Kreativa Teacher Development Program
program.tagline: Grow as an educator. Make an impact.
program.intro: A structured development program combining professional training, mentoring, and real classroom experience to prepare you for a teaching career at Kreativa Global School.

items.title: Cambridge Curriculum
items.body: Learn to apply Cambridge curriculum standards and assessment practices.

items.title: English for Teaching
items.body: Develop your English communication skills for classroom teaching.

items.title: Effective Pedagogy
items.body: Learn to plan and deliver lessons that support student learning.

items.title: Understanding Students' Cognitive Development
items.body: Child development, learning psychology, individual learning needs.

items.title: Classroom Experience
items.body: Practical experience through classroom observation, microteaching, and guided teaching.

items.title: Kreativa Teaching Culture
items.body: Explore long-term career paths in teaching specialization or school leadership.

items.title: Professional Certification
items.body: Kreativa Teaching Academy certificate upon completion.

items.title: Subject Specialists
items.body: Graduates with strong subject knowledge, including those without a teaching background.

requirements.title: Requirements
items: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field from a reputable university
IELTS 6.0+ for Kindergarten–Primary or 6.5+ for Secondary–High School, or equivalent English proficiency
Commitment to Islamic values and education
Experience with the Cambridge curriculum is preferred

steps.title: Employment
steps.body: Successful participants begin teaching at Kreativa Global School.
